fusions.name: Meteor Orbit
fusions.desc: Swings the head round on its tether, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocking them back 2 tiles, with a 60% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Skipping Links
fusions.desc: Casts the head out on its tether to strike the first enemy in its path for 7 damage. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives a charge back.

fusions.name: Stake and Tether
fusions.desc: Hammers a stake into the ground ahead of you. For 5 seconds its 5-tile tether drags every enemy near it inward.

fusions.name: Mail in the Making
fusions.desc: Every hit you land forges a link on you, up to 10. At 10 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per link. Unfed, a link fades every 6 seconds.
